_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test:
Use an access key: on the first screen choose Use an access key and enter the venue code, terminal number and key from Terminals in the back office.
Stripe Tap to Pay (sandbox) at The Vesopa Kitchen, once it is switched on under Who takes the cards.
Settings kept in the back office: change a setting, reinstall, and check it comes back.
release_notes: License a device with an access key, and keep its settings safe in the back office.
